intent: PSI-001: turn the workspace into a git repository on main with a fresh history, keep the template LICENSE, add no upstream remote, and confirm the template installs and boots.
summary: Claimed PSI-001 (owner agent:claude-code, status doing). The repo root is this folder (human choice), with the Kiranism template kept unmodified under frontend-architecture/ next to its LICENSE. Added a root .gitignore (node_modules, .env* and **/.env*, generated graphify-out and obsidian-out except its README, .hermes.md, .ecc/) and checked the staged list first: 648 files, no secrets, backend-architecture/.env excluded. git init -b main, one initial commit a194aae, no history before it. bun install works (through npx bun, because bun is not installed globally): 464 packages. bun run dev starts (Next.js 16.2.12 Turbopack, Ready in 646 ms) but every page returns HTTP 500 'Missing publishableKey' because the template still requires Clerk; that is PSI-002's job, so the template was not touched. typecheck, lint and build all pass on the untouched template. Outcome is partial because (1) pages do not render until Clerk is removed, and (2) the repo has an origin remote to https://github.com/ardianhermawan17/super-dashboard-p3md.git that this session did not add and cannot explain; it is the owner's own repo, not the Kiranism upstream, so it was left alone and nothing was pushed. Earlier work in the same chat is captured by the initial commit: four superseded monolith docs moved to docs/_archive/, obsidian-sync now mirrors docs, README_AI_AGENT.md and the graph report into obsidian-out/, a graphify graph was built, and a root package.json with ajv was added for the sync script.
